Author: Rakesh Thapliyal
Bench: Rakesh Thapliyal
 Office Notes,
Sl. Date reports,
No. orders or Court'S Or Judge'S Order

S  proceedings  or directions  and  Registrar's  order with  Signatures  C482 No. 990 of 2024  Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1.
Mr. Dharmendra Barthwal, learned counsel for the applicants.

2. By the present C482 application, the applicants are challenging the charge sheet dated 18.07.2023 as well as summoning order dated 16.04.2024 wherein the present applicants have been summoned for the offence punishable under sections 504 and 498A IPC.
3. Facts in brief are that the applicants' son married with respondent no. 2/ complainant on 25.11.2020 and out of this wed-lock one child was born who is living with respondent no. 2.
The husband of respondent no. 2 filed a divorce suit being O.S. No. 241 of 2022, which is pending in the Family Court, Dehradun.
Apart from this, respondent no. 2 also filed a suit for restitution of conjugal rights wherein counseling also got failed on 08.05.2024.

4. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that efforts should be made for the amicable settlement since there are chances that the applicants' son may live with the respondent/complainant and for that purposes husband of respondent no. 2 be also called along with the applicants.
5.
Mr. V.K. Jemini, learned Dy. Advocate General with Ms. Meenakshi Sharma, learned Brief Holder accepts notice for respondent no. 1.

6. Issue notice to respondent no. 2 returnable within two weeks.
7.
Learned counsel for the applicants shall take steps to serve respondent no. 2 within a week.
8. Mr. V.K. Jemini, learned Dy. Advocate General may also intimate to respondent no. 2 through the S.H.O. concerned.

11. Till the next date of listing, for an interim measure, further proceedings of Criminal Case No.
2726 of 2023, State vs. Gaurav Kathait & other, pending in the Court of 5th Addl.
